review.note: Release 0.3.1 adds the optional shared pytest source runner component without changing snapshot schema, pytest arguments, ownership, deadlines, or runtime requirements. Added dev-only pytest-xdist>=3.8.0. Reviewed https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html and https://execnet.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html: xdist 3.8.0 adds optional loadscope ordering controls; default scheduling remains consumer-owned. Its local workers copy the controller import path and inherit Python cache environment settings. Normal resolution installed pytest-xdist 3.8.0 and execnet 2.1.2 with pytest 9.1.1 on Python 3.14.1. Actual two-worker regressions cover candidate versus old sibling source, equal-size/timestamp module caches, pytest assertion caches, worker source identity, private-cache cleanup, exact environment restoration, selection/exit statuses, and corrupt snapshot rejection: 21 tests passed. Another 17 source-entry and snapshot regressions passed; strict mypy, Ruff, formatting and Markdown passed. Registry discovery confirms all existing direct dependencies remain at the versions reviewed for 0.3.0: hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, Ruff 0.17.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3. Their previously reviewed official release notes remain applicable: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md . No bounds are relaxed or pinned. Native Windows execution is delegated to the existing platform CI, not claimed from local tests. Fresh distribution validation, online review and the complete canonical gate remain separate required evidence.
